s2_candidate.fill_classifier: imported verbatim from frozen S1, not weakened
s2_candidate.reprice_on_displacement_source: EVIDENCE_REFRESH.md offset_ticks p99 of L5's own fills
s2_candidate.reprice_on_staleness_source: EVIDENCE_REFRESH.md max observed same-token inter-fill gap

per_window.arm_definition: A: book only, the frozen module's own condition (last_prints never assigned). C: third-party prints with every L5 leg removed.

s1_divergence.definition: D2: the first second at which L5 holds a matched pair and S1 holds none. Chosen as the marker because it is the first divergence in POSITION rather than in quote.

per_window.selection_bias_note: EVIDENCED_LEVEL_CONSUMED fires only when the best bid has fallen strictly below our price, so these fills are the subset whose book movement went against us. Benign fills are returned as UNCERTAIN_PARTIAL and excluded. Acquisition prices and settlement here are NOT an unbiased estimate of hypothetical maker fills.

mint_ceiling_on_fill_count_gap.note: even granting every mint opportunity, the remainder of the gap is resting-bid flow neither S1 nor S2 obtained
